source_inspection_only: The Round7 collector uses its recorded retirement instant for the loop deadline and copies the terminal callback list before survivor disposal. The Round6 collector reads its local loop start before emitting the phase mark.

Production retirement skips an already completed posting and permits one stop attempt per posting. LateUpdate supplies entity-retired and OnDestroy supplies view-destroyed. A successful request and a subsequent completion are separate observations.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: Both row shapes refuse a first stop after completion was observed at zero attempts, and refuse a retirement-frame stop stamped after the first sample. A stop already attempted on the first sample’s tick can still complete later and characterize.

Round7 refuses another sample after a preceding sample reaches or passes the deadline. The two-late-sample control refuses in both shapes. A final sample crossing its own guard and a callback first seen in the terminal list remain valid.

Round6 now bounds disposal using the later posting plus the declared duration and the last sample. Its between-deadlines control accepts 20:29:14.3258000Z and refuses 20:29:14.3000000Z. Round7 retains its exact deadline check.

Both representations accept a terminal callback sharing the disposal stop’s tick and a disposal stop sharing the deadline’s tick. A strictly later callback and a strictly earlier in-window stop still refuse.

Both pre-disposal survivor counts now distinguish two attempts as impossible. The two-shape regressions also cover zero, one, negative and oversized values. The developer implemented the diagnostic distinction that OWNER AMENDMENT 2 made optional.

The settled completion reader distinguishes an omitted field, a malformed timestamp and an explicit null in both representations. All three refuse, while the valid completion characterizes. This verifies the local fix to the distinction made optional by OWNER AMENDMENT 2.

A successful stop credited to retirement now requires entity-retired or view-destroyed. Both shapes refuse empty and unrelated causes, accept the production causes, and preserve the failed-call outcome. The other cue’s completion is checked separately.
